name: refactoring
description: Two refactoring catalogs as one Agent Skill: Fowler's Refactoring (2nd ed.) and Kerievsky's Refactoring to Patterns. 29 code smells, 66 refactorings and 27 refactorings to patterns, each with mechanics and a C# example, plus two subagents: one finds smells and plans, the other applies one refactoring.
